name: EXS Choco Lube 100ml Water Based Lubricant
description:
Indulge your senses and enhance intimacy with EXS Choco Lube, a premium water-based chocolate-flavoured lubricant designed to ease dryness and elevate pleasure. Perfect for use with a partner or solo play, this vegan-friendly lube offers smooth, gentle, and safe lubrication.

Key Features:

Chocolate Flavoured: Adds a sensual, delicious twist to intimate moments.

Water-Based & Gentle: Smooth, non-sticky, and hydrating; easy to apply and wash off.

Versatile Use: Can be applied directly or on condoms; safe for use with latex condoms.

Skin-Friendly & Vegan: Gentle on sensitive skin and cruelty-free for ethical use.

High Safety Standards: CE marked and compliant with UK and European safety regulations.

Ingredients: Hydroxy Ethyl Cellulose, Glycerin, MonoPropylene Glycol, Citric Acid, Chocolate Flavour, Sodium Saccharin, Methyl Hydroxybenzoate, Deionized Water.

Brand: EXS (UK)
Pack Size: 100ml

Experience smooth, safe, and flavorful intimacy with EXS Choco Lube – 100ml, the perfect addition to your bedroom routine.
